rows.quote: In this work, we performed a GWAS of senile cataract in the All of Us (AoU) research program cohort, and then conducted ancestry-stratified GWAS meta-analyses of cataract in European and East Asian participants to advance understanding of its genetic architecture.
rows.coder_note: Decision order step 3 (rules C, C2): the authors' own GWAS of senile cataract on All of Us individual-level data, defined in the passages by a phenotype definition (SNOMED/ICD codes), the Controlled Tier dataset version 8 and a described REGENIE procedure, not only by a number of participants; the outcome side has no All of Us row.

rows.quote: For plasma protein instruments in European ancestry, two large pQTL datasets were used: the deCODE proteomics study (n = 35,559) and the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP, n = 46,281).21,22 Protein levels were measured using the SomaScan platform in deCODE and the Olink platform in UKB-PPP, as described in the original publications.
rows.coder_note: Decision order step 2: the sentence gives the exact N 35,559 for the deCODE proteomics study together with the SomaScan platform, matching exactly the Ferkingstad 2021 row (the Eldjarn 2023 row has 35,892); the first of the two ordered citations (21, Ferkingstad 2021) agrees, and nothing conflicts. Reference 23 (Eldjarn 2023) in p001 of the UKB-PPP row supports a statement on sample size and is not an attribution of the deCODE data.
